translations.web: You shall dwell with us, and the land will be before you. Live and trade in it, and get possessions in it.”
translations.bsb: You may settle among us, and the land will be open to you. Live here, move about freely, and acquire your own property.”
translations.kjv: And ye shall dwell with us: and the land shall be before you; dwell and trade ye therein, and get you possessions
translations.asv: And ye shall dwell with us: and the land shall be before you; dwell and trade ye therein, and get you possessions therein.
